title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title \- Sr. Business Analyst – Senior Analyst \- ACS Song**

**Management Level 10\-Sr. Analyst**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Requirement Analysis**

**Good to have skills: Business Process Tools**

**Experience: 3\-5 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


You’ll capture user requirements and translate them into business and digitally enabled solutions across a range of industries.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Analyzing as\-is and design to\-be processes to define business, solution and system requirements.
* Organizing and facilitating workshops with clients to elicit and understand their requirements.
* Interacting with various (client) stakeholders to, gain a deep understanding of their needs and represent that knowledge to the rest of the team, while using analysis techniques like story mapping, process modelling and data\- and document analysis.
* Managing the requirements life cycle
* Facilitating effective communication between the team and acting as a point of contact for clarifications on product backlog items
* Iteration planning, backlog refinement, creating user stories and story acceptance criteria is also part of your scope.
* Stakeholder management and being an interface between your team, the customer and the project manager.
* Identifying various solution options to satisfy our client’s requirements and helping them and our teams make the right decision by carefully weighing business value and technical complexity.
* Creating and detailing user stories based on criteria set by client or your practice
* Collaborating with key external and internal project stakeholders who have a direct impact on their role and deliverables (e.g., decision\-makers, Subject Matter Experts)
* Ensuring that requirements and designs at an implementation level are aligned to one another, and managing the changes to related requirements
* Retaining requirement accuracy and consistency throughout and beyond the change during the entire requirements life cycle, and supporting the reuse of requirements in other solutions

  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* Experience in producing implementation\-ready product backlog items based on the elicited requirements
* Experience in understanding initial product backlog/ inception documentation to be able to form a complete picture of project scope
* Skilled in engaging with clients, vendors, and internal teams to align expectations and deliverables.
* Excellent verbal and written communication for reporting, presentations, and team coordination.
* Ability to mentor, motivate, and manage cross\-functional teams across geographies.
* Proficiency in JIRA, MS Project, or similar platforms.
* Understanding of development, testing, deployment, and maintenance phases.
* Knowledge of automation pipelines, version control, and deployment strategies.
* Relevant application knowledge of any commerce platforms like SAP Hybris, commerce tools or similar could complete your profile.

**Additional Information**

title: Lead Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title \- Lead Business Analyst – Specialist \- ACS Song**

**Management Level: 9 – Specialist**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Requirement Analysis**

**Good to have skills: eCommerce techno\-functional BA**

**Experience: 5\-8 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled commerce solutions**.** The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst who can work independently in client\-facing engagements, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and enable delivery teams through clear requirements, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Independently lead requirements elicitation for assigned eCommerce workstreams by facilitating client workshops, interviews and playback sessions.
* Analyze as\-is processes and design to\-be business, solution and system requirements in partnership with client stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Create and maintain epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, business rules, data needs and decision logs.
* Own backlog readiness for upcoming sprints by planning refinement, identifying dependencies and clarifying functional and technical questions.
* Act as a bridge between client Product Owner, business SMEs, UX/design, architects, developers, QA and project/program stakeholders.
* Identify solution options and recommend fit\-for\-purpose approaches by balancing business value, user experience, feasibility and delivery complexity.
* Ensure requirements and designs remain aligned throughout change, implementation, testing and release cycles.
* Support UAT planning, test scenario review, defect triage and business readiness activities.
* Contribute to product roadmap inputs, release scope definition and improvement ideas based on client priorities and market/platform awareness.
* Mentor junior team members on BA ways of working, quality of user stories and stakeholder communication.
* Expected to operate with limited supervision in a client\-facing consultative BA role.
* Own medium\-complexity functional areas or workstreams and escalate risks with mitigation options.
* Maintain clear communication rhythms with client stakeholders and internal teams.
* Demonstrate strong analytical thinking, outcome orientation and ownership for BA deliverables.
* Provide constructive challenge to requirements prioritization and help shape backlog value.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail pages, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility and order status.
* Ability to map business journeys and identify functional gaps across B2B/B2C commerce, marketplace, omnichannel and customer\-service\-enabled commerce experiences.
* Working knowledge of commerce platform concepts such as catalog, product information, pricing display, promotions, campaigns, search, merchandising, content, customer accounts and integrations.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Understanding of APIs, events, integrations, data flows and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce platforms.
* Ability to independently own a commerce feature area such as product discovery, checkout, promotions, account management, order management, or content/merchandising.

  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* Advanced user story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Story mapping, customer journey mapping, as\-is/to\-be process modelling and gap analysis.
* Scrum/Agile delivery experience across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release phases.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Ability to work with product owners, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication for client presentations, demos, decisions and status reporting.
* Draw.io, Miro, Visio, Lucidchart or similar modelling/diagramming tools.
* CPQ \& Pricing domain knowledge
* Commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento or similar.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
* Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event\-driven integrations or cloud\-native delivery.
* Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration

**Additional Information**


About Our Company \| Accenture (do not remove the hyperlink)

title: Associate Manager Business Analyst
description:
**Job Title \- Associate Manager Business Analyst – Associate Manager \- ACS Song ACS Song**

**Management Level: 8 – Associate Manager**

**Location: Kochi**

**Must have skills: Techno\-functional BA lead with eCommerce experience**

**Good to have skills: Should have worked with multiple Commerce platforms**

**Experience: 8\-10 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


You will help clients translate business and user needs into digitally enabled commerce solutions. The role requires a consultative techno\-functional Business Analyst who can work independently in client\-facing engagements, connect business objectives with platform capabilities, and enable delivery teams through clear requirements, backlog readiness and stakeholder alignment.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead the Business Analysis workstream for eCommerce delivery, owning BA approach, requirement governance, quality standards and stakeholder alignment.
* Partner with client Product Owners, business sponsors, solution architects and delivery leads to shape scope, roadmap and prioritization decisions.
* Run senior stakeholder workshops to frame business problems, define outcomes, identify value levers and align on implementation approach.
* Guide as\-is/to\-be process design, capability mapping, gap analysis, backlog strategy and release scoping across multiple functional areas.
* Build/review epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications
* Identify solution options and make recommendations that balance business value, user experience, platform constraints, delivery risk and technical complexity.
* Own requirements traceability, change impact analysis and decision management across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release.
* Lead cross\-functional ceremonies involving client business users, product owners, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, data/integration and program management.
* Drive issue resolution and decision closure for complex or escalated functional questions.
* Support estimation, staffing, transition planning, pre\-sales/RFP inputs, reusable assets and practice/capability development as needed.
* Expected to operate as a BA lead/associate manager who can independently represent the BA function to clients and delivery leadership.
* Own complex and ambiguous eCommerce problems, mobilize the right stakeholders and drive structured recommendations.
* Coach and review the work of junior BAs, ensuring consistency, quality and delivery readiness.
* Influence senior stakeholders through consultative communication, business value framing and clear decision options.
* Contribute to account delivery health by identifying risks, gaps, dependencies and continuous improvement opportunities.
* Strong understanding of digital commerce capabilities including product discovery, product detail pages, cart, checkout, order capture, promotions, payment, inventory visibility and order status.
* Ability to map business journeys and identify functional gaps across B2B/B2C commerce, marketplace, omnichannel and customer\-service\-enabled commerce experiences.
* Working knowledge of commerce platform concepts such as catalog, product information, pricing display, promotions, campaigns, search, merchandising, content, customer accounts and integrations.
* Ability to collaborate with product owners, experience designers, architects and engineering teams to convert experience and business objectives into implementation\-ready backlog items.
* Understanding of APIs, webhooks, events, integrations, data flows and non\-functional requirements relevant to commerce platforms.
* Ability to lead multiple commerce capability areas across discovery, cart/checkout, order management, customer account, promotions, content, search, merchandising and customer service touchpoints.
* Ability to assess commerce platform capability fit, define functional architecture inputs and guide business trade\-off decisions with architects and delivery leads.

  

**Professional and Technical Skill**

* Business analysis and requirements analysis for digital products or commerce platforms.
* User story writing, acceptance criteria definition and backlog refinement.
* Jira and Confluence proficiency; ability to maintain product backlog, decisions, traceability and release documentation.
* Workshop facilitation, stakeholder interviews, process mapping and requirements elicitation.
* Story mapping, customer journey mapping, as\-is/to\-be process modelling and gap analysis.
* Scrum/Agile delivery experience across discovery, inception, construction, UAT and release phases.
* eCommerce domain knowledge across browse, search, PDP, cart, checkout, payments, promotions, order capture and order status.
* Techno\-functional understanding of APIs, integrations, data flows, analytics tagging, non\-functional requirements and platform constraints.
* Ability to work with product owners, UX, architecture, engineering, QA, release and client business stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication for client presentations, demos, decisions and status reporting.
* Draw.io, Miro, Visio, Lucidchart or similar modelling/diagramming tools.
* Understanding of SDLC phases including development, testing, deployment, maintenance and release governance.
* CPQ \& Pricing domain knowledge
* Commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce/Hybris, commercetools, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce/Magento, Shopify or similar.
* Search, merchandising, CMS, CDP, web analytics, payments, OMS or customer service platform exposure.
* PSPO I, PSPO II, CBAP, Agile BA, Scrum Master or relevant commerce platform certifications.
* Exposure to headless commerce, composable commerce, microservices, event\-driven integrations or cloud\-native delivery.
* Experience with automation pipelines, version control, deployment strategies or DevOps collaboration.

**Additional Information**
